description_en: Disassociates a Log Service Logstore from an endpoint group
description_zh: 调用DetachLogStoreFromEndpointGroup接口解除SLS日志库和终端节点组的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun ga detach-log-store-from-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-ids epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachLogStoreFromEndpointGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId for each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
